text: Swedish author Lars Gustafsson wrote a novel about the death of someone associated with these things, while in Anita Desai's Clear Light of Day, Tara abandons Bim after an encounter with them. For 10 points, name these curved yellow insects that buzz and make honey.

text: A contemporary of Brecht, this Frenchman compared his own ideas to the plague, but meant it in a good way. Well, he did suffer from mental illness for many years. If this seems a tad ambiguous, you're not alone: he is hailed as a great influence on theater, partially because of the opposing interpretations of his few works. FTP, name this author of the essay collection The Theater and Its Double, the progenitor of the "theater of cruelty."
